body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 6d7af620f8bf0d9f0f22869862a81e0de11e911e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a delta review of `a509bbd74..6d7af620f`. It is the independent safety-floor check on the new head.

### Prior finding - met
1. The holder could move along the axis when the `CENTRELINE` LINE was drawn top-down. The fix removes that failure:
   - `crates/tools/src/tool_profile_dxf.rs:122` refuses a centreline whose endpoints differ in X. `:127` takes the lower endpoint as the origin. The axis and normal are fixed to drawing `+Y` and `+X`, so the draw direction cannot change the placement.
   - The convention is stated in the MCP description (`crates/app/src/mcp/holder_dxf_tools.rs:23`) and in the import tooltip (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs:148`), as asked.
   - `dxf_centreline_direction_cannot_move_or_flip_the_holder` draws the reversed LINE and three translations, and asserts one profile. It also pins the documented lower-end offset. `dxf_centreline_not_parallel_to_y_is_refused_by_name` covers the horizontal, tilted and reversed cases. This matches the test that the finding asked for.
   - Export still writes the centreline `(0, 0)` to `(0, z_top)` (`crates/app/src/tool_profile_dxf.rs:26`), so the new refusal cannot break a round trip.

### Results merged with main
Built locally on Windows, in a trial merge of `6d7af620f` with `origin/main` (clean merge, no conflicts).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-tools --lib` | 90 passed |
| `camcraft-tools --test tool_dxf_profile` | 4 passed, including the two new pins |
| `camcraft-app --test tool_dxf_profile` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test tool_dxf_profile_mcp` | 1 passed; it asserts the four convention strings |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` `tool_profile` | 9 passed; it pins the tooltip strings |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No NC, CL, G-code or PNG golden changed in this delta. The trial merge tree carried the fix and both guards.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The guard `dc.x != 0.0` is an exact comparison. A centreline tilted by 1e-9 mm is refused by name, and the test states that intent. This is safe; a tolerance would accept more files. No action needed.
- The mirror-side path (profile wholly at negative X) is handled by the normal flip in `project_to_spun`. No test imports such a profile; the refusal suite only shows the crossing case. A small positive test would pin it.
- `crates/ui/src/state_tool_profile.rs` is still 412 lines. The earlier split note stands.
- The PR body still names `crates/geometry/src/dxf/writer.rs` and `crates/app/src/tool_profile_dxf_import.rs`. The current files are `crates/geometry/src/dxf/document_writer.rs` and `crates/tools/src/tool_profile_dxf.rs`. Please update the body.
- We do not rely on the review comment on this head by mkinney's own agent. This review ran its own builds and tests.

State: `merge-ready` is kept as set by the author. No label was changed. The PR stays ready (fork PR; its state was left as the contributor set it).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
